title: StrengthSpears
description: Spears are now affected by Strength and Weakness effects, making them viable options as weapons.
body:
Spears are now affected by Strength and Weakness effects, making them viable options as weapons.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/bjJxV4bWsYg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

In vanilla, the Spear's charge attack isn't affected by strength or weakness, making it quite useless. Now with strength applied, the Spear can be a powerful yet not overpowered weapon—— cheaper and less lethal than a mace, yet greater than the sword if utilized well.

This mod does not buff the spear's kinetic damage or add any additional buffs, it only changes a method call so that the spear's base damage is affected by strength and weakness.
